topography.project_purpose: Predict Fun is a decentralized prediction market protocol enabling users to trade on event outcomes. It supports both non-yield-bearing and yield-bearing conditional token markets, with integrated UMA oracle resolution and a shared vault for collateral management.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Non Yield Bearing and Yield Bearing families share the Vault and UMA oracle from the Shared family, with adapters bridging conditional token logic to the oracle. The Predict Fun family on Blast appears to be a standalone deployment reusing similar conditional token patterns but without direct integration to the shared vault.
